citation.title: First application of data assimilation-based control to fusion plasma
citation.authors: Morishita, Y.; Murakami, S.; Kenmochi, N.; Funaba, H.; Yamada, I.; Mizuno, Y.; Nagahara, K.; Nuga, H.; Seki, R.; Yokoyama, M.; Ueno, G.; Osakabe, M.

topic: Ensemble Kalman filter data assimilation of real-time Thomson Te/ne profiles into a TASK3D transport model for ECH power control on LHD (helical device).
own_question: Can DA-based adaptive predictive control adjust ECH power so that central electron temperature reaches a target in LHD?
actual_method_and_evidence: ASTI ran 256 TASK3D ensemble members with EnKF. It assimilated 10 Hz real-time Thomson electron Te/ne, mapped by an MLP to 11 rho points, every 0.3 s and switched gyrotrons every 0.1 s. In one shown discharge (#186500), central Te reached the 4 keV target. Reported prediction error was up to about 2 keV in the transient phase and about 0.2 keV in steady state. The authors state that performance did not exceed conventional PID control.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Sequential ensemble data assimilation has been used online in a fusion device to update a physics transport model using real-time electron profile measurements, with explicit observation-noise treatment.
claim_checks.qualification: Electron Thomson data on an LHD helical device. Physics-model-based model-predictive control, not CES impurity Ti nowcasting. One discharge is shown.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In that work, delayed or infrequent observations limited adaptation, and model mismatch caused large transient errors.
claim_checks.qualification: This is the authors' interpretation for their own system only.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs: Thomson Te/ne, with a reported delay of tens of ms; 0.3 s observation interval; 0.1 s control interval. Target: a future central Te setpoint. This is not current-report nowcasting.
validation_if_relevant: Single control discharge shown. The MLP mapping used 58 discharges with a one-quarter test split. There is no held-out control-performance comparison.
forbidden_inferences: Not evidence for CES, impurity or ion temperature, KSTAR, BES or ECEI.
Not evidence that DA outperforms PID or other baselines.
Not a general claim that prior fusion estimation is noncausal.
Our study did not implement DA or control.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Useful theory and background context: a causal Bayesian/DA framing for combining past measurements with models in real time, which contrasts with our empirical downstream nowcasting of current CES reports.
